issues.description: Image bytes are pushed downstream as raw RGB without conversion, will produce corrupted/garbled output for non-RGB modes
issues.detail: `Image.open(io.BytesIO(part.inline_data.data))` returns a PIL Image whose mode depends on the source bytes (e.g., RGBA, P, L, CMYK for PNGs returned by Gemini). The code passes `image.tobytes()` directly with `format="RGB"`, but `tobytes()` returns bytes in the image's native mode, not RGB. The size (width*height*3) declared by `OutputImageRawFrame` will mismatch the actual buffer length for any non-RGB image, producing garbled frames or downstream decoding errors. The fix is `image = image.convert("RGB")` before `tobytes()`.

issues.description: Monkey-patching `genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE` at import time is a fragile hack on a private API
issues.detail: The diff comments this as a "Temporary hack" and mutates a private attribute of `google.genai._api_client`. This breaks silently if google-genai renames or removes the attribute (the dependency is pinned `>=1.41.0,<2`, so future 1.x releases may already differ). It also has global, process-wide side effects for any other consumer of google-genai in the same process. At minimum this should be wrapped in `try/except AttributeError` with a logged warning, and a TODO referencing an upstream issue/fix.

issues.description: Default model change from `gemini-2.0-flash` to `gemini-2.5-flash` is a breaking behavior change for existing users
issues.detail: Changing the default model in `GoogleLLMService.__init__` will silently alter latency, cost, and output behavior for any caller that doesn't explicitly pass `model=`. This is logged under "Changed" in CHANGELOG.md but should be called out more prominently as potentially breaking (especially given pricing/throughput differences between 2.0-flash and 2.5-flash). Consider keeping the old default for one release with a deprecation notice, or at minimum flag this as a migration note.

issues.description: Example pipeline routes a vision-only model through STT/TTS without handling the absence of text output
issues.detail: `examples/foundational/07n-interruptible-gemini-image.py` wires `gemini-2.5-flash-image` into a pipeline that still expects spoken text (TTS in the chain, system prompt says "output will be converted to audio"). When the model returns only an image (which is the demo's stated purpose), TTS has nothing to speak and the assistant context aggregator receives no text turn, which can cause the conversation to stall or produce empty assistant turns. The example should either use a non-image model with image tool-call or handle text-only/image-only branches explicitly.

issues.description: Generated images are not added to assistant context — multi-turn image references will fail
issues.detail: The new branch pushes an `OutputImageRawFrame` but never appends the image part back into the LLM context (`context.add_message` or equivalent). On a follow-up user turn referencing "the image you just made," the model will have no record of having produced one. Either store the inline_data in the assistant context, or document this limitation in the example.

issues.description: `OutputImageRawFrame` is constructed without verifying it's importable/needed when image generation is unused
issues.detail: `OutputImageRawFrame` is now imported unconditionally at module top. This is fine, but `Image` (PIL) and `io` must also be imported for the new branch to run — verify they remain imported (likely already are via the existing image-handling code paths in this file). If not, this branch will NameError at runtime only when an image is returned.

issues.description: Image-model detection uses substring match `"image" in self._model_name`
issues.detail: The thinking-budget bypass triggers on any model name containing the substring "image". This is currently fine for `gemini-2.5-flash-image`, but is fragile if Google introduces models like `gemini-image-reasoning` where thinking budget might actually apply. Consider a more explicit check (e.g., known set, or `endswith("-image")`).

issues.description: Stray blank line added in `__init__` with no functional change
issues.detail: An empty line was inserted between `self._http_options = http_options` and `self._create_client(...)`. Harmless, but pure noise in the diff.

issues.description: Dependency lower bounds widened to `<3` without testing across the range
issues.detail: `google-cloud-speech>=2.33.0,<3`, `google-cloud-texttospeech>=2.31.0,<3`, `google-genai>=1.41.0,<2` — broadening from `~=` to a wide range is good for compatibility but means future minor releases may break the `_api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE` hack or other private-API assumptions silently. Combine with the hack noted above: at minimum pin a tighter upper bound until the upstream fix lands.

dissents.topic: Severity of the RGB tobytes() issue

positions.position: P0 — silently producing wrong-sized image buffers is a correctness bug that will manifest as garbled frames or crashes the first time Gemini returns a non-RGB-encoded image (very likely, since PNG is common). Block merge.

P1 — Gemini's image generation in practice often returns 3-channel data and the example may happen to work; ship and patch in a follow-up. But everyone agrees a one-line `convert("RGB")` fix is trivial, so blocking is cheap.

Reaching into `genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE` is unacceptable in library code — it's a private symbol and a global mutation. Should be resolved upstream or guarded with try/except + warning before merge.
It's explicitly labeled a temporary hack with a clear comment, and image generation otherwise doesn't work. P1 nit at most; land the feature and track removal.
Changing a default model is a breaking change for production users on cost-sensitive workloads. Should be a major-version bump or held back.
Gemini 2.5-flash is the modern default; aligning with current Google guidance is correct. CHANGELOG entry suffices.

review.summary: The PR adds image-generation support to `GoogleLLMService` via a new `inline_data` branch, bumps the default model to `gemini-2.5-flash`, widens google-* dep ranges, and ships an example. The most important issue is a correctness bug: `image.tobytes()` is pushed with `format=\"RGB\"` without first converting the PIL Image to RGB mode, which will produce wrong-sized buffers for any non-RGB output (likely on real Gemini PNG returns). A close second is the private-API monkey-patch of `genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE` at import time, which should at least be guarded and clearly TODO'd against an upstream fix. Secondary concerns: the default-model change is effectively breaking and under-flagged, generated images are not written back into the assistant context (multi-turn image references will fail), and the example pipeline routes a vision-output model through TTS without handling the no-text case. Fix the RGB conversion (one line) before merge; everything else can land as P1 follow-ups.
